modules.module_title: Prepare to harvest the NTFP and MAPs

pcs.pc_description: identify the NTFP and MAP collection permitted forest areas by contacting the relevant authorities such as the Divisional Forest Officer or Range Officer
select the variety of NTFP and MAPs for collection based on the market demand and price, ensuring the selected varieties are not endangered or protected
arrange the appropriate tools, equipment and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for the collection of NTFP and MAPs

plan the collection of NTFP and MAPs according to the season, harvesting calendar for the identified NTFP and MAPs and selected collection area, ensuring compliance with the applicable regulatory requirements
check the NTFP to ensure that it meets the applicable quality standards such as required growth, damage and pest-free, etc.
harvest the relevant parts of the selected NTFP such as root, rhizome, bark, gum, resin, flower, etc.
use sustainable harvesting methods and appropriate tools and equipment to ensure no negative impact on the future produce
follow the applicable forest biodiversity conservation practices while collecting NTFP, and collect the harvested NTFP in the appropriate baskets, bags or containers
maintain the record of harvested NTFP as per the guidelines issued by the forest authority and the relevant regulatory body
select the MAPs with the required characteristics and the recommended season to harvest
ensure the MAPs are free from pests, insects and disease
identify the appropriate potent parts of the MAPs intended for medicinal/ commercial use such as root, bark, seeds, flower, gum, resin, etc.
sterilise the relevant tools and equipment before use
use the approved harvesting method and relevant tools and equipment to harvest the MAPs according to the variety and as per the specific use/ industry requirements
isolate and handle the poisonous plants and weeds following the recommended safety procedures

follow the applicable health and safety standards while harvesting and handling the MAPs to maintain their quality and prevent contamination, collecting them in the appropriate basket, bags or containers
record the relevant data with respect to the harvested MAPs, such as the genus of plant, local name, geographical origin, geo-coordinates (whether endangered/ threatened), etc.

modules.module_title: Sort and grade the NTFP and MAPs

pcs.pc_description: sort out the damaged, deceased and unwanted NTFP and MAPs
grade the remaining NTFP and MAPs on the relevant grading parameters such as appearance, size and marketability as per the requirement of the specific industry
arrange the sorted and graded produce in bundles and stacks for further processing
carry the NTFP and MAPs to the storage area using an appropriate mode of transport

modules.module_title: Clean and process the NTFP and MAPs

pcs.pc_description: select an appropriate method of cleaning, suitable to the NTFP and MAPs such as dry cleaning/ wet cleaning/combination of both
clean the NTFP and MAPs according to the selected method
dry the NTFP and MAPs under the sun/ using a solar dryer and drying sheds/ on perforated bamboo-mats/ smoke on low fire to the desired moisture level as per the proposed end use
carry out further processing such as grinding, milling, oil extraction according to the produce
select a weatherproof storage area with the appropriate temperature, humidity and air- circulation according to the NTFP and MAPs to be stored
apply the necessary treatment in the storage area to protect the produce from pests, insects and rodents
arrange the necessary accessories for the storage of produce such as racks, crates, pallets, etc.
store the produce in the storage area following the applicable guidelines to protect it from damage
follow the recommended practices in the storage area to minimise the loss of active ingredients and oils in the produce
tag the produce according to the area to maintain purity, prevent mixture with other produce and for better price
record the data of produce processed and stored
optimise the usage of water, electricity and other resources in various tasks and processes
plug water leakages to prevent its wastage
use the power-operated tools and equipment safely and disconnect them when not in use
segregate waste into different categories
dispose the non-recyclable waste in an environment-friendly manner
recycle the recyclable waste appropriately

modules.module_title: Set the price for NTFP and MAPs

pcs.pc_description: identify the market demand and supply for the NTFP and MAPs

obtain information about the minimum support price (MSP) and fair pricing for the NTFP and MAPs from the relevant authority such as the Tribal Co-operative Marketing Development Federation of India (TRIFED), Biodiversity Management Committee (BMC), District collector, Minor Forest Produce Committee (MFPC), etc.
set the price for the NTFP and MAPs in compliance with the fair pricing directives issued by the regulatory body

identify the potential buyers of NTFP and MAPs through the appropriate marketing channels such as Tribes India/ Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)/ State Emporia/ local retail outlets/ wholesalers/ fairs and exhibitions, etc.
connect with the potential buyers to assess their needs and negotiate the price
use electronic payment methods for accepting payments such as Bharat Interface for Money - Unified Payment Interface (BHIM UPI), payment apps, e-wallet etc.
use the relevant digital platform for the trading activities
comply with the regulatory requirements in the marketing of NTFP and MAPs
maintain the manual and/ or electronic record of sales and payments using the physical registers and/ or the relevant computer application

modules.module_title: Pack and transport the NTFP and MAPs

pcs.pc_description: arrange appropriate packing material capable of protecting the varieties of NTFP and MAPs during transit
pack different NTFP and MAPs as per their packing requirements
apply label on the NTFP and MAPs packaging with the relevant information such as the date and time of packing along with the geographical origin
obtain the necessary approval from the relevant authority to transport the produce
arrange an appropriate mode of transport to deliver the produce to the target market/ buyer
load the produce in the transport vehicle safely
maintain the record of the produce packed and transported along with the payment in the physical registers or a relevant computer system
collaborate to form clusters based on geographic proximity or the types of NTFPs one collects
engage in co-operatives or other collective structures that promote equitable sharing of resources, profits, and responsibilities
aggregate the harvest for value-addition to enhance their competitiveness
participate in forest conservation efforts as a part of the NTFP harvesting community
